FIELDS.NAME: Shutter & Lens Studio
FIELDS.CONTACT FOR INSPECTION: Jane Doe, Lead Operations Manager, (555) 123-4567, jane.doe@shutterlensstudio.com
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Shutter & Lens Studio is a retail camera and photo supply store dedicated to providing high-quality photographic equipment and accessories, including cameras, lenses, tripods, and lighting solutions. We offer a diverse range of products, catering to both amateur and professional photographers. Our knowledgeable staff is passionate about photography and is available to assist customers in finding the right tools for their creative needs. Additionally, we provide photography workshops and classes in our store, fostering a community of learners. Our operations adhere strictly to local business licensing and tax regulations, ensuring we maintain a compliant and successful retail environment. Our inventory is carefully managed, typically not exceeding $500,000, which allows us to maintain financial stability and manageable risk levels.
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: On 03/15/2023, we experienced a theft of camera equipment from our store, resulting in a loss of $10,000. This incident was reported to local authorities, and the status is currently "under investigation." Additionally, on 07/20/2023, minor water damage was incurred due to a burst pipe, which cost $5,000 to repair, and this claim has been settled.
FIELDS.SAFE/VAULT DETAILS: Commercial Grade Safe, UL RSC Class, 2-hour fire rating.
FIELDS.OTHER PROTECTION: Security fencing and 24/7 surveillance monitoring system.

FIELDS.G10: Are you involved in manufacturing,: No – Shutter & Lens Studio is not involved in manufacturing, mixing, relabeling, or repackaging of products as part of its retail operations. The focus is solely on selling high-quality photographic equipment and accessories.
FIELDS.G11: Do you rent or loan equipment to ot: No – Shutter & Lens Studio does not rent or loan equipment to others as part of its operations. This policy helps to minimize risk and maintain control over the equipment provided to customers.

FIELDS.G14: Any catastrophe exposure?: No – Shutter & Lens Studio does not have any catastrophe exposure as its operations are focused on retail sales of photographic equipment and do not involve high-risk activities typically associated with catastrophes.
FIELDS.G15: Any past losses or claims relating: No – Shutter & Lens Studio has no past losses or claims relating to sexual abuse or molestation allegations, discrimination, or negligent hiring. The business operates with a commitment to ethical practices and compliance with all regulations.
